segments.title: Stop typing: 3 free AI tools
segments.say: Stop typing. Three AI dictation tools with free plans.

segments.title: 1. Granola Voice Typing
segments.say: One: Granola Voice Typing, free on every Granola plan.

segments.title: Granola: Mac only (beta)
segments.say: On a Mac, hold F N and talk. It removes the ums and adds punctuation.

segments.title: 2. Wispr Flow
segments.say: Two: Wispr Flow. Free on Mac, Windows, iPhone and Android, with a weekly word cap.

segments.title: 3. Superwhisper
segments.say: Three: Superwhisper. Its free plan dictates with on-device models.

segments.title: Free plans have limits
segments.say: Free plans change, so check each one's limits.
Save this, and follow for a free tool every Friday.
